summary: Full frontend test of JMA Campus Map single-street rework + Astronaut helmet bug fix. All 7 feature groups PASS end-to-end: single-street render (play=7, learn=5, create=3, default=play), DOM order on PLAY street (jukebox, shred, stew, note-match, detective, sight-reading, robot — Stew & Dr.Jellybone no longer adjacent), 15/15 building assets under assets/campus/* with naturalWidth>0 (stew uses stew-room-kazoo.png), no floating on 390x844 (all 7 PLAY buildings sit on green slab), sky=night (hour=20) with moon DIV + stars + no sun img (correct for night), BlimpFlyby renders with data-testid=blimp-flyby and blimp sprite imgs, strollers (3 imgs) animate with changing transforms, ambient Audio built per zone with loop=true & volume=0.22 for assets/ambient/{play|learn|create}.mp3, previous track pause() is called on zone change and on leaving campus, voices-off reload yields zero ambient Audio constructions. Astronaut helmet bug fix verified: outfit-astro tile has data-unlocked=true + [data-helmet=true] wrapper with 4 SVGs; preview sprite exposes data-helmet=true + 4 SVGs + dr-jellybone-astro-1.png; Home avatar renders helmet (4 SVGs); Shred crowd YOU member renders helmet wrapper with 4 SVGs + astro img; selecting outfit-classic removes the helmet wrapper. Regression (unlock_all=0, no stickers) still shows locked chips on non-starters, data-locked=true, and clicking starter stew-kazoo navigates to /#/simon-says. No pageerrors observed on Campus/Dressing Room/Home/Shred (only expected noise: Vimeo 401 and asset 401s).
critical_code_review_comments: CampusMapPage.js: duplicate-key React warning observed in console on Campus mount — worth auditing map keys (strollers or buildings list). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

Minor: avatar-preview-sprite retains data-helmet='true' attribute even after switching to outfit-classic (helmet wrapper child is correctly removed, so visual is fine). Not spec-breaking; the spec only requires wrapper removal on classic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Avatar storage key is jma_avatar_v1 with shape {character, outfit} (NOT characterId/outfitId). Shred crowd-you data-testid is on the small YOU badge span; helmet wrapper is a sibling under the parent motion.div — query via parentElement. Campus sun is only an when data-sky != 'night'; when night, [data-testid=campus-sun-moon] is a DIV with data-kind='moon'. Audio prototype patch via add_init_script works reliably to track ambient construction/pause.
